description: Tasks for the Java 25 LTS runtime upgrade plan.

tasks.description: Upgrade Java from version 21 to Java 25 LTS. Addresses assessment issue: Java Version is not the latest LTS (azure-java-version-02000).
tasks.reason: The assessment identifies Java 21 as older than the latest LTS version, and the user selected Java 25 LTS.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application's Java runtime and build target from Java 21 to Java 25 LTS. Preserve current application behavior and avoid upgrading Spring Boot or changing cloud-readiness, credential/security, containerization, or database scope. Verify that the project builds and existing unit tests pass with Java 25.
